description: Table 1 is a single two-row, seven-column composition table rendered as an image, with no plot axes, legend or scale bar. The header row is labelled "Element" and lists six elemental columns left to right: Mn, Al, C, Ni, O, Fe. The data row is labelled "Mass" and gives the corresponding values Mn = 29.95, Al = 8.63, C = 1.20, Ni = 3.45, O = 0.01, and Fe = "Bal." (balance). Horizontal rules are drawn above the header row and between the header and data rows, so the table is fully legible at the supplied resolution. The caption identifies the table as "Table 1 Chemical composition of the Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni powder (wt%)", so the tabulated numbers are mass percentages in the powder feedstock. The citing text states that the powder was spherical Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni prepared by the plasma rotating electrode process (PREP, Advanced Corporation for Materials and Equipment, PREP-22) with a particle diameter of 15–53 μm, and that the composition was determined by inductively coupled plasma (ICP-OES). The table therefore documents the nominal feedstock chemistry — nominally Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni — showing measured Mn, Al, C and Ni slightly below the nominal designation, and a very low measured oxygen content of 0.01 wt%, which the paper associates with the low-oxygen powder feedstock used for selective laser melting.

observations.observation: The table lists six elements in the order Mn, Al, C, Ni, O, Fe in the header row labelled "Element".
The row labelled "Mass" gives Mn = 29.95, Al = 8.63, C = 1.20, Ni = 3.45, O = 0.01, with Fe reported as "Bal." (balance).
The caption states the table is "Table 1 Chemical composition of the Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni powder (wt%)", so the tabulated values are in wt%.
The measured Mn content of 29.95 wt% is slightly below the nominal 30 wt% implied by the alloy designation Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni.
The measured Al content is 8.63 wt% and the measured C content is 1.20 wt%.
The measured oxygen content is very low at 0.01 wt%.
The citing text states the powder composition was determined by inductively coupled plasma (ICP-OES).
The citing text states the powder was spherical Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni with a particle diameter of 15–53 μm, prepared by the plasma rotating electrode process (PREP, PREP-22).
Nickel is present at 3.45 wt%, close to the nominal 3 wt% of the alloy designation.
